requirements.section: PART 13 — ADVANCED MIDI AND PIANO ROLL
requirements.text: # PART 13 — ADVANCED MIDI AND PIANO ROLL
requirements.remaining: Individual acceptance is not fully certified. Area evidence and gaps: Native source notes now support interactive snapped mouse/touch draw, move, resize/delete, keyboard and exact table editing, with meter-aware1/2/4-bar windows/24-pitch banks/512 visible notes. Reviewed Vanessa note commands share music.native.edit; real PCM, one Undo/gesture, live dialog Undo/Redo refresh, locks and saved reopen are tested. MIDI import/export and16/32/64-step sequencing/flam/roll remain preserved. Nine fixed chord qualities/inversions, one-shot correction and persistent native scale locking now share manual/reviewed Vanessa music.native.edit, real PCM/MIDI, locks, history and saved reopen. A lock preserves old notes; new/pitch-edited notes/chords/transpose map to its explicit key/scale, and keyboard steps stay in scale. Drum sounds pause mapping; pitched sounds resume it. MIDI carries actual notes, not editor-lock metadata. Chord recognition/progression generation, live MIDI/controllers, expression lanes/MPE/microtuning, probability/pattern chains and full DAW parity remain. Retrospective MIDI capture remains unimplemented and must be opt-in.
